_columns: B top width; outstand = flange outstand beyond fillet; fillet_h = horizontal leg of web-flange fillet; web; bottom_width; haunch_h = bottom haunch height (horizontal leg = (bottom_width-web)/2); side_h = vertical bottom-flange side ABOVE the soffit chamfer; chamfer = soffit corner chamfer (both legs); web_h = straight web height; left/right = [fillet_v, underside taper, edge thickness, printed total height at that edge]; centre = printed height at the axis
geometry_notes: All dimensions read visually from the raster drawings (zoomed), cm; the vertical chains on both sides and the widths close exactly on the printed totals except GT115 (below).

Top flange carries a 2.5 % crossfall drawn in different directions per size (GT95/GT140/GT185 high on the right, GT115 high on the left); implemented exactly as drawn, so the outline is asymmetric. Origin at mid-soffit.

GT115 right chain prints 7 + 2.8 + 5 + 74.9 + 10 + 12 + 2 = 113.7 but the right total is printed 113.6 (= 116.4 - 112 x 2.5 %); the right underside taper is taken as 2.7 so the printed total governs (0.1 cm).
GT185: printed edge-height difference 187.5 - 183.5 = 4.0 cm over 180 cm (2.2 %, not 2.5 %), and their mean 185.5 differs from the printed nominal 185; printed chain totals used (pinned in tests).
GT185 soffit chamfer 1.5 x 1.5 is dimensioned on the right corner only; applied to both corners (symmetric convention).
Top flange edges are vertical; web-flange junctions are straight chamfer-type fillets with the printed legs; bottom haunches straight from web face to flange edge.
